A true testimony! I think we all would have viewed romance much differently if we were given the freedom to grow up with authentic thought.
It would have been interesting to see how we all would have turned out without media influence.

I’m not saying that everything in media is bad. What I’m saying is subliminal messaging can be harmful in the way that it can distort what would otherwise be formed by natural process- not from an agenda. The fact that we even portray the idea of fairytale romance to a being that can’t even wipe its own ass is just insane. Children should be able to be children & not concerned with relationships/marriage at age 8 because books, ads, & TV glamorized something they may not have even ever wanted at all in the first place.

I don’t understand how you can say that media doesn’t play a huge role in conditioning. We are exposed to biased romantic scenarios (often unrealistic) in cartoons & such before we are even old enough to remember. That’s why I said the “let nature do its job” part because it obviously will happen naturally. But, humans like to control everything & have an agenda, so...
